description: Defines the HpackDecoderStringBuffer class used in HPACK decoding within HTTP/2, managing string buffers for header literals with Huffman decoding support.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStringBuffer
classes.description: Manages string buffers for HPACK decoding, supporting Huffman decoding, buffering, and state management.

methods.name: HpackDecoderStringBuffer
methods.description: Constructor for the string buffer class.

methods.name: ~HpackDecoderStringBuffer
methods.description: Destructor for the string buffer class.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer state to initial.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the buffer with a string view and static flag.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Begins processing a string, indicating Huffman encoding and length.

methods.name: BufferStringIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Buffers the string if not already buffered.

methods.name: IsBuffered

methods.description: Returns a string_view to the collected string.

methods.name: GetStringIfComplete
